sources.snippet: openpi holds open-source models and packages for robotics, published by the Physical Intelligence team. sources.title: mstar.model.pi05.config — M* v0.2.0 Documentation
sources.snippet: Pi0.5 combines a SigLIP vision encoder with two Gemma transformer experts: PaliGemma (Gemma-2B backbone) processes the prefix (image + text + state tokens) and writes a KV cache; an action expert (Gemma) reads that frozen cache and runs a 10-step Euler flow-matching loop with adaRMS timestep conditioning to produce a 50-step robot action trajectory.
